speaker: Patient
text: The baby has been very fussy, feeding less than usual, and the abdomen looks distended. Crying gets worse when the belly is touched.

speaker: Doctor
text: That sounds quite painful for you. Did you notice any blood or mucus mixed in with your stools, or has your bowel movement pattern changed recently?

text: There has not been fever, vomiting, or diarrhea like a stomach infection. The baby was born at 39 weeks without birth complications.

speaker: Doctor
text: No fever or vomiting is good to hear. Since touching his belly makes him cry and he has abdominal distension, I need to check if there is a palpable mass or organomegaly.
